purpose: Define translations per label/context/language with explicit fallback and completeness semantics for Finnish, English, Japanese, Vietnamese, Korean and French targets.

topics.name: Translation Set
topics.purpose: Define translations per label/context/language with explicit fallback and completeness semantics for Finnish, English, Japanese, Vietnamese, Korean and French targets.

semantics.label_rule: Translation binds exact UI label identity.
semantics.fallback_rule: Fallback chain is explicit and deterministic.
semantics.missing_rule: Missing translation remains explicit or uses declared fallback; it never changes internal identifier.
semantics.quality_rule: Translation approval/review state may be explicit.
semantics.context_rule: Context metadata remains available to translators/tools.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.
